Thus, the size of the precipitates in the annealed alloys can be considered suitable for obtaining SFH.
These sufficiently fine NiAl precipitates can cause SFH even at 973 K as well as at RT.

evidence.section: 3.2 Phase Transformation Behavior and Microstructure Evolution of 4Mn
evidence.quote: The Laves phase precipitates in the temperature range from 1 073 K to 1 173 K.
the Laves phase acts as a nucleation site for the fine α grains in the prior fcc regions and suppresses the grain growth of the α grains due to the grain boundary pinning effect.
The suppression of brittle intergranular fracture due to formation of fine grain regions is responsible for improving large ductility at RT.
